468:t_011:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You who inherit the soul of $$ゼウス$$! Fall into the darkness!」

468:t_013:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't let your guard down, $$ガラダブラ$$. Here they come.」

468:t_014:2.en:
$$渓$$
「It's no good! He's completely lost consciousness!」

468:t_014:3.en:
$$凱$$
「That idiot...! He heard $$ガラダブラ$$ was back and charged off on his own, didn't he!」

468:t_014:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$甲児$$ isn't just passed out...! Someone is sealing away his consciousness!」

468:t_014:7.en:
$$ボス$$
「What the heck is that supposed to mean!?」

468:t_014:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I can feel it...! A dark, rotten stench!」

468:t_014:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Whoever's possessing $$マジンガー$$, show yourself!!」

468:t_014:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「So you sensed me. Well done, I'll grant you that much.」

468:t_014:12.en:
$$隼人$$
「So you are the grudge of the $$ハーデス$$ we defeated!」

468:t_014:13.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Exactly! Now I am the Emperor of Darkness!」

468:t_014:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「E-Emperor of darkness? That's the evil boss, hands down!!」

468:t_014:16.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「E-Emperor of darkness? That's the evil boss, hands down!!」

468:t_014:17.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「E-Emperor of darkness? That's the evil boss, hands down!!」

468:t_014:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Are you the one possessing $$甲児$$ and sealing away $$マジンガー$$'s power!」

468:t_014:19.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It would be a nuisance if this one's power of light were to awaken.」

468:t_014:20.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Now, $$ガラダブラ$$! Make the grudges that fill this land your power!」

468:t_015:0.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Ohh! My blood, my flesh, in the mortal world once more!」

468:t_015:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Is this the power of Lord $$ハーデス$$, King of the Underworld!」

468:t_015:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now we can fight again! We can take revenge on those hateful humans!」

468:t_015:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Unlike the survivors of $$ミケーネ$$ we met at the center of the galaxy, it looks like they've come back from the bottom of hell!」

468:t_015:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Hold on! You mean everything we fought for in the $$時獄戦役$$ was for nothing!?」

468:t_015:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahahaha! This is the eternity of the gods, higher-dimensional life forms!」

468:t_015:6.en:
$$渓$$
「The $$機械獣$$s have been revived too...!」

468:t_015:7.en:
$$號$$
「So $$ハーデス$$ is the root of everything!」

468:t_015:8.en:
$$凱$$
「If we don't take him down, will the fight with $$ミケーネ$$ go on forever!?」

468:t_015:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「$$ガラダブラ$$! Leave this to us and heal your wounds!」

468:t_015:10.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Understood! I leave it to you, my brethren!」

468:t_016:1.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「It's no use, $$さやか$$! Right now $$マジンガー$$ is under the control of $$ハーデス$$'s power!」

468:t_016:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That can't be...! Then what should we do!?」

468:t_016:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「First we defeat those monstrous gods and recover $$マジンガー$$.」

468:t_017:0.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Um, $$竜馬$$... it's great that you're fired up, but aren't you getting too far out in front...?」

468:t_017:1.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「And we're honored that you picked us, but a $$ボロット$$ would only hold $$真ゲッター$$ back...」

468:t_017:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry. I'll do the fighting, so I'm counting on you guys to handle supply in the rear.」

468:t_017:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「That's fine and all... but why are you being so reckless?」

468:t_017:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, commence the attack. And do not neglect caution against the $$ミケーネ神$$s.」

468:t_017:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「They may only call themselves gods, but gods they are. Their power is not to be underestimated.」

468:t_017:8.en:
$$メール$$
「Geez...! Where has $n gone at a crucial time like this!」

468:t_017:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's not a man who does pointless things...! I'm sure he's fighting somewhere!」

468:t_017:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, $$ミケーネ$$! This time I'll sink you to the bottom of hell so you can't float back up!!」

468:t_017:11.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahahaha! Struggle all you like, humans! In this land filled with the grudges of $$ミケーネ$$, you have no chance of winning!!」

468:t_018:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This abnormal lethargy all over my body... Is this the power of grudge they were talking about?」

468:t_018:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahahaha, humans! Offer up your souls to me!」

468:t_020:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If we keep this up, we might just manage it...!」

468:t_021:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, humans! From here, the hero $$ガラダブラ$$ will face you again!」

468:t_021:1.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You handed that title over to us!」

468:t_021:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Now that my body has been restored, it's only right that I take it back.」

468:t_021:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「You call yourself a hero, and you're so petty!」

468:t_021:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「This is no time to be saying that!」

468:t_021:5.en:
$$凱$$
「This is bad! We're pushing our machines past their limits to get $$甲児$$ back!」

468:t_021:6.en:
$$渓$$
「Without $$マジンガー$$ or $$ジェニオン$$, this is too tough...!」

468:t_021:8.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It's useless, girl! This one's power of light is now imprisoned in my darkness!」

468:t_021:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Get up, $$甲児$$!! You're not the kind of man who ends in a place like this!」

468:t_022:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「You! Where the heck have you been at a time this insanely busy!」

468:t_022:2.en:
$n
「I'll explain the details later! For now, the proprietress is safe!」

468:t_022:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「The proprietress...? You mean from $$くろがね屋$$...!?」

468:t_023:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

468:t_023:1.en:
$n
「$$甲児$$! I brought you Photon Power energy!」

ハーデス様 = 'Lord $$ハーデス$$' (title, cf. Lord Guen precedent), 468:t_013:0, t_015:1
闇の帝王 = 'Emperor of Darkness'; 冥府の王 = 'King of the Underworld'; 光子力エネルギー = 'Photon Power energy' (no glossary entry for 光子力)
468:t_014:19/t_021:8: Hades' こやつ = 'this one' (Kouji); 468:t_021:1 ヴィラル: 'that title' = 勇者 (hero)
